name: CircuitPython client (indexed PNG)
description: Composition PNG quantized to the panel's palette and emitted as an indexed PNG sized for adafruit_imageload on CircuitPython microcontrollers. Output is 1-bit (mono panels) or 4-bit indexed (Spectra 6, 7-colour ACeP, or unknown gamuts fall back to Spectra 6). The device paints what arrives without an on-device quantize or dither pass, which keeps RAM usage on Pico-W class hardware to just the framebuffer plus a small streaming decode buffer.

settings.name: contrast
settings.label: Pre-dither contrast
settings.help: Push midtones toward black or white before the dither pass. 1.0 leaves the image alone; > 1.0 deepens contrast (good for photos with grey skies); < 1.0 softens (good for text-heavy dashboards).
